**Cause:** In `django/db/models/expressions.py`, the `_connector_combinations` type-inference table has a block for "numeric operations — operands of different type" (`IntegerField`/`DecimalField`/`FloatField` combinations), but its connector tuple only listed `ADD, SUB, MUL, DIV` — `MOD` was missing. **Fix (one line, source only, matches upstream commit `cff1f888e9` exactly):**

```diff
--- a/django/db/models/expressions.py
+++ b/django/db/models/expressions.py
@@ -533,6 +533,7 @@
             Combinable.SUB,
             Combinable.MUL,
             Combinable.DIV,
+            Combinable.MOD,
         )
```
